headline: Global Markets Rise Following US Midterm Setback for Trump, While Argentine Assets Lag
summary: Global stock markets rose following the US midterm elections and the defeat of Donald Trump's economic agenda, while Argentine bonds fell amid concerns over bilateral relations, debt swaps, and ongoing litigation.
why: US congressional shifts alter domestic policy execution and international economic relations, directly affecting emerging market debt and sovereign risk premiums.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Local Argentine sovereign bonds dropped amid broader market volatility and political shifts.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Expectations of restrained political maneuvering in Washington reduced policy uncertainty globally, while localized debt concerns weighed on Argentine assets.
